title: The Road
author: Cormac McCarthy
description: It's a post-apocalyptic world, and unlike The Walking Dead, no one has a generous amount of supplies; it's rare that people form unions. Father and son are navigating this world and they are on the last reserves of food. What should a father do to ensure that his son survives? What sacrifices does the father need to make? What's the father's duty? What are his goals? His objectives?
reasons: want a post-apocalyptic novel stripped down to a father and a son
like spare, bleak prose where every sentence earns its place
want to feel what protecting someone costs
can handle a book that is beautiful and very dark
